title: Repair source segmentation, record boundaries, and complete locators
description:
Repair known heading/ownership/continuation/locator defects and strengthen source-side
structural checks so those defect classes cannot silently recur. The denominator for
an exhaustive assertion must come from independently observed source structure, not
the generated records being checked. Historical counts are evidence, not acceptance
constants.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known boundary and continuation defects are repaired and generalized against independently observed source structure.
- A source continuation cannot be silently represented with a partial locator.
- Ambiguous/unresolved ownership remains explicit and cannot count as clean source coverage.
- Historical hand-copied counts are not authoritative membership.
- Corpus-wide structural predicates are allowed only when their denominator is independently source-derived.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
ADR-0020 authority reconciliation applied 2026-09-10 by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.5.
The operative title/description/acceptance criteria supersede contradictory
